body: Installed lino-env 0.2.8 declares links-notation ^0.11.2, while the consumer root uses current links-notation 0.25.2. The npm graph keeps a nested 0.11.2 copy and prevents an all-latest own-maintained grammar graph without a potentially unsafe override. Please assess the current parser API, migrate the range with roundtrip and cross-platform configuration tests, and document compatibility. This is a maintenance/deduplication request, not a claim that the old version caused a local app failure. Keep current behavior verified, including existing CRLF regression issue #32. A coordinated lino-arguments dependency migration is requested separately; browser-commander#168 reports its analogous older range. Consumer validation reference: https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/commit/20ac35d50129157769c2460d88ffe564ceab7d73 . No private inputs are involved.
title: Assess and update the Links Notation range for latest consumer interoperability
